title: Fire rate
instructions: Hold the trigger on the bot. From 5 s to 20 s the server accepts shots every 50 ms, twice the rifle's cycle.

card.what_this_tests: Shots accepted faster than the weapon's declared cycle.
card.server_knows: The server time of every shot it accepted. The profile declares the rifle's cycle: 100 ms, 15 ms slack.
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: The fire-rate check fires: gaps under 85 ms, at least 20 gaps and 10 violations in matches where they are the habit. Decision review.
card.invalid_if: Shot timestamps are not the server's, or the profile's cycle does not match the weapon.

caveats: The metronome check stays quiet on a held trigger: the server paces those shots at the rifle's own cycle, and the profile says shots are stamped on server ticks (shot_clock server_tick, tick_ms 17).
The lab lowers the server's own cycle enforcement on purpose, standing in for a server that accepts what a macro sends. The detector reads what the server accepted.
